assignment: fixed disagreement-prioritized seed order; opaque deterministic per-seed per-session list order
playback: approximately 20-second strongest-recurrence excerpt; no full-track seeking; recurrence heuristic, not a verified chorus classifier
rating_scale: required integer 0-10 for each complete list or result rating; optional closed-enum result mismatch reasons
attribution_release: a list overall score and all five result ratings must be complete before seed or list attribution is shown
feature_hypothesis: prior ratings motivated the feature hypothesis but were not used to fit weights
